# Kernel conformance corpus (design spec §9, C3). Every kernel implementation
# must agree on these verdicts. Format:  verdict | term | inferred-type(optional)
# verdict is `accept` (infer succeeds; type checked if given) or `reject`.
# Terms and types use the C2 S-expression format (Cure.Core.Serialize).
accept | (int 5) | (int-type)
accept | (int -7) | (int-type)
accept | (float 1.5) | (float-type)
accept | (ctor True) | (data Bool () ())
accept | (int-type) | (type 0)
accept | (data Bool () ()) | (type 0)
accept | (type 0) | (type 1)
accept | (prim add (int 3) (int 5)) | (int-type)
accept | (prim mul (int 4) (int 6)) | (int-type)
accept | (prim add (float 1.0) (float 2.0)) | (float-type)
accept | (prim lt (int 3) (int 5)) | (data Bool () ())
reject | (prim not (ctor True))
accept | (prim neg (int 5)) | (int-type)
accept | (pi (int-type) (type 0)) | (type 1)
accept | (sigma (int-type) (int-type)) | (type 0)
accept | (lam (int-type) (var 0))
accept | (eq (int-type) (int 1) (int 1)) | (type 0)
accept | (refl (int 1))
reject | (prim add (int 1) (type 0))
reject | (prim lt (ctor True) (int 2))
reject | (prim and (int 1) (int 2))
reject | (app (int 5) (int 3))
reject | (var 0)
reject | (prim add (int 1))
reject | (fst (int 5))
reject | (type 2)
